title: Stage 3 序列评估运行图
subtitle: 说明 FrontRES Segment Replay 的整段序列评估路线. Block ID 对应源码注释; 除特别说明外, 证据来自代码确认和 fake-runner contract.

nodes.title: CLI 暴露 sequence_eval 模式
nodes.role: 给 Stage 3 命令面加入 sequence_eval, 序列数, rollout 长度, smoke-test preroll 上限.
nodes.input: Stage 3 launch command: mode=sequence_eval, OFFLINE_EVAL_SEQUENCES, OFFLINE_EVAL_STEPS, OFFLINE_EVAL_MAX_PREROLL_STEPS.
nodes.output: 解析后的序列离线评估参数.
nodes.forbidden: 请求 sequence_eval 时不能进入训练或 segment-local offline_eval.

children.title: 分发评估并退出训练路径
children.role: 调用 runner.run_frontres_segment_sequence_offline_eval, 评估后关闭 env.
children.input: 解析后的 sequence_eval flag, num_eval_sequences, rollout_steps.
children.output: 只运行一次评估, 在正常训练前 return.

children.title: Runner 只做薄 API
children.forbidden: Runner method 不能拥有 sequence sampling, reset, metrics 逻辑.

nodes.title: 构造唯一 motion 序列计划
nodes.role: 选择唯一 motion id, 可按 max_preroll_steps 过滤 smoke-test 样本, 并定义 reset_frame=0, preroll_steps=start_frame, eval window.
nodes.input: 来自 live Segment Replay sampler 的 candidate segment specs.
nodes.output: FrontRESSegmentSequenceEvalPlan, 每个唯一 motion sequence 一个 item.
nodes.forbidden: 不能把 env count 当序列数, 不能直接从 segment frame 开始评估, smoke test 不能静默跑超深 preroll.

children.title: 按 B1 layout 重复同一 segment
children.role: 用同一个 segment id 填满 env batch, 让 repaired/noisy/clean 比较同一个 motion.
children.input: 一个 sequence eval item 和 env_count.
children.output: 重复后的 segment id tuple.
children.forbidden: 同一个 B1 comparison group 内不能混入不同 motion.

children.title: 构造 frame0 reset batch
children.role: 把 sampled segment specs 改写为 start_frame=0 用于 reset, 同时保留原 eval item 边界和 Stage 3 动态扰动字段.
children.input: Eval batch 和 sequence eval item.
children.output: specs 从 motion frame 0 开始的 reset batch.
children.forbidden: 不能修改原 eval batch start_frame, 不能丢失 stage3_index_perturbation_family/strength.
children.diagnostic: runtime-confirmed: frontres_segment_sequence_eval_contract.py reset batch assertions keep local_rp.

nodes.title: 收集候选 sequence specs
nodes.role: 采样 index-only batches, 直到获得足够唯一 motion specs, 并满足可选 preroll cap.
nodes.input: FrontRES segment sampler 和请求的 sequence count.
nodes.output: 传给 sequence plan builder 的 candidate spec list.
nodes.forbidden: 只发现候选序列时不能运行 rollout.

children.title: 每轮只评估一个 sequence
children.role: 遍历 plan.items, 让每个 motion sequence 拥有独立 reset/preroll/eval 生命周期.
children.forbidden: 不能把 preroll 长度不同的无关 sequences 合到同一个 metric window.
children.diagnostic: runtime-confirmed: frontres_segment_sequence_eval_contract.py emits two reset and four rollout events for two sequences.

children.title: Reset -> 不采集 preroll -> 采集 eval
children.role: 打印逐序列进度和 preroll 长度, 静默 reset trace, preroll 不存 motion-quality frames, eval window 才采集.
children.input: Reset batch, live observations, preroll_steps, eval_rollout_steps.
children.output: 只覆盖 scoring window 的 FrontRESSegmentLiveRolloutCapture.
children.forbidden: Preroll 不能存 motion-quality frames, evaluation 不能刷屏 perturbation reset trace.

children.title: 应用 index-only reset
children.role: 把当前 reset batch 应用到 live env, 并记录 reset request/result.
children.forbidden: 当前 sequence reset batch 存在时不能跳过 env reset.

children.title: 运行 live rollout capture
children.role: step live env 并采集 transition/reward/done; motion-quality frames 由 flag 控制.
children.diagnostic: runtime-confirmed: contract test distinguishes preroll_no_capture=True from eval_capture=True.

nodes.title: 附加 sequence 元数据
nodes.role: 给每个 sequence summary 加入 motion id, reset frame, preroll steps, eval start frame, perturbation family/strength.
nodes.output: 带明确时间边界的逐序列 summary.
nodes.forbidden: 不能报告缺少 motion-sequence 边界或 perturbation family 的 segment metrics.

children.title: 合并 sequence summaries
children.role: 对 numeric metrics 求平均, 同时保留 per-motion rows 和 motion ids.
children.forbidden: 不能丢掉用于审查弱序列的 per-motion rows.

children.title: 打印紧凑结果日志
children.role: 输出逐序列进度/结果, final 和 per-motion success/fall/survival, score gain, MPJPE, velocity error, acceleration error, action norm, perturbation family, motion ids.
children.forbidden: 不能从训练日志里隐藏长序列进度, final motion ids, perturbation family, motion-quality metrics.
